title: Pills handed out during intuitive communication training
place_text: Undisclosed facility near the NSA complex, Maryland

tellings.quote: And so, and he told me also there would be some pills that I would take.

plain: Between 1990 and 1993, the men in a secret programme training them to talk with aliens by thought were given pills, at an undisclosed facility near the NSA complex in Maryland. Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him for this work, tells Michels he went through the training. He says an officer he calls Captain White 'told me also there would be some pills that I would take', which suggests the training used drugs as well as practice.
